# Tickets

Manage tickets (support cases) in Teamleader Focus.

```php
Teamleader::tickets()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Tickets\Tickets` |
| Create / update / delete | ✓ / ✓ / — |
| Pagination | `page_size` / `page_number`; no totals — a short page is the last one. Every page: [`lazy()` / `cursor()`](../../guides/pagination.md#fetching-everything) |

## Endpoints

- `tickets.addInternalMessage`
- `tickets.addReply`
- `tickets.create`
- `tickets.getMessage`
- `tickets.importMessage`
- `tickets.info`
- `tickets.list`
- `tickets.listMessages`
- `tickets.update`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `assignee_ids` | Array of user UUIDs; a null entry matches unassigned tickets |
| `exclude.status_ids` | Array of status UUIDs to exclude |
| `ids` | Array of ticket UUIDs |
| `project_ids` | Array of project UUIDs |
| `relates_to.id` | Related entity UUID |
| `relates_to.type` | Related entity type (contact, company) |

## Accepted values

Public constants on the class. Body fields and enum values outside these lists
throw before the request is sent.

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| `CREATE_FIELDS` | `subject`, `customer`, `ticket_status_id`, `assignee`, `custom_fields`, `description`, `participant`, `initial_reply`, `milestone_id`, `project_id` |
| `CUSTOMER_TYPES` | `contact`, `company` |
| `INITIAL_REPLY_OPTIONS` | `automatic`, `disabled` |
| `MESSAGE_FILTERS` | `type`, `created_before`, `created_after` |
| `MESSAGE_TYPES` | `customer`, `internal`, `thirdParty` |
| `REQUIRED_ON_CREATE` | `subject`, `customer`, `ticket_status_id` |
| `SENT_BY_TYPES` | `company`, `contact`, `user` |
| `UPDATE_FIELDS` | `subject`, `description`, `ticket_status_id`, `customer`, `assignee`, `participant`, `custom_fields`, `milestone_id`, `project_id` |

## Methods

### `info()`

```php
info($id, $includes = null): array
```

Get detailed ticket information

- `$id` — Ticket UUID
- `$includes` — Optional includes

### `create()`

```php
create(array $data): array
```

Create a new ticket

Required fields: subject, customer, ticket_status_id

Optional linkage (mutually exclusive):
- milestone_id (string): link to a legacy-projects milestone
- project_id (string): link to a new-projects project

- `$data` — Ticket data

### `update()`

```php
update($id, array $data): array
```

Update an existing ticket

Optional linkage (mutually exclusive; pass null to unlink):
- milestone_id (string|null): link to a legacy-projects milestone
- project_id (string|null): link to a new-projects project

- `$id` — Ticket UUID
- `$data` — Data to update

### `addReply()`

```php
addReply(string $ticketId, string $body, ?string $ticketStatusId = null, array $attachments = []): array
```

Add a customer-facing reply to a ticket

- `$ticketId` — Ticket UUID
- `$body` — HTML formatted message body
- `$ticketStatusId` — Optional status UUID to update
- `$attachments` — Optional array of file UUIDs

### `addInternalMessage()`

```php
addInternalMessage(string $ticketId, string $body, ?string $ticketStatusId = null, array $attachments = []): array
```

Add an internal message (note) to a ticket

- `$ticketId` — Ticket UUID
- `$body` — HTML formatted message body
- `$ticketStatusId` — Optional status UUID to update
- `$attachments` — Optional array of file UUIDs

### `importMessage()`

```php
importMessage(string $ticketId, string $body, string $sentByType, string $sentById, string $sentAt, array $attachments = []): array
```

- `$ticketId` — Ticket UUID
- `$body` — HTML formatted message body
- `$sentByType` — Type of sender (company, contact, user)
- `$sentById` — UUID of sender

## Examples

Get all tickets:

```php
$tickets = Teamleader::tickets()->list();
```

Get tickets for a specific customer:

```php
$tickets = Teamleader::tickets()->forCustomer("company", "company-uuid");
```

Get tickets for specific projects:

```php
$tickets = Teamleader::tickets()->forProjects(["project-uuid-1", "project-uuid-2"]);
```

Get detailed ticket information:

```php
$ticket = Teamleader::tickets()->info("ticket-uuid");
```

Create a new ticket:

```php
$ticket = Teamleader::tickets()->create([
    "subject" => "Customer issue",
    "customer" => ["type" => "company", "id" => "company-uuid"],
    "ticket_status_id" => "status-uuid",
    "assignee" => ["type" => "user", "id" => "user-uuid"]
]);
```

Update an existing ticket:

```php
$result = Teamleader::tickets()->update("ticket-uuid", [
    "subject" => "Updated subject",
    "ticket_status_id" => "new-status-uuid"
]);
```

Add a customer-facing reply to a ticket:

```php
$result = Teamleader::tickets()->addReply(
    "ticket-uuid",
    "<p>Thank you for your inquiry...</p>",
    "status-uuid"
);
```

Add an internal note to a ticket:

```php
$result = Teamleader::tickets()->addInternalMessage(
    "ticket-uuid",
    "<p>Internal note about this ticket...</p>"
);
```

Get all messages for a ticket:

```php
$messages = Teamleader::tickets()->listMessages("ticket-uuid");
```

Get a specific message:

```php
$message = Teamleader::tickets()->getMessage("message-uuid");
```

Import an existing message (e.g., from email):

```php
$result = Teamleader::tickets()->importMessage(
    "ticket-uuid",
    "<p>Message content...</p>",
    "contact",
    "contact-uuid",
    "2024-02-29T11:11:11+00:00"
);
```
